dataset_name: Indian Soil Health Card & Geochemical Survey (SHC-OGD)
organization: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI / ICAR-NBSS&LUP
state_coverage: Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, etc.
soil_properties: pH, EC, Organic Carbon (OC), N, P, K, S
limitations: Focuses on agricultural trace metals (Zn, Cu, Fe, Mn) rather than toxic Pb/Cd/Cr

dataset_name: Tamil Nadu Industrial & River Basin Heavy Metal Soil Survey
organization: TNAU / Published Academic Repositories (Noyyal & Palar Basin Studies)
heavy_metals: Pb, Cd, Cr, Ni, Cu, Zn, As
target_candidates: Pb, Cd, Cr, Ni, Zn, Cu
limitations: Regional extent focused on industrialized catchment basins

dataset_name: South India Granitic & Agricultural Soil Geochemical Dataset
organization: Mendeley Data / Academic Consortium (South India Shield)
soil_properties: pH, Major Oxides (SiO2, Al2O3, Fe2O3), Soil Organic Carbon
heavy_metals: Cr, Ni, Cu, Zn, Pb, As, Co
limitations: Medium sample density across granitic terrain

dataset_name: Indo-Gangetic Basin Wastewater & Industrial Soil Monitoring
coordinate_quality: Medium (GPS sampling points along peri-urban transects)

soil_properties: pH, Soil Organic Carbon, Major Minerals
heavy_metals: Pb, Cd, Cr, Ni, As, Cu, Zn, Hg
limitations: Non-Indian; does not capture tropical Indian soil pedogenesis or monsoonal climate
